malta/review.delegate_statement: Malta explained that the Focal Point would consult petitioners and collect information from several sources. Its report would help the sanctions committees deliberate and decide.
malta/review.adopted_document: The Council expressed its intention to keep reviewing the Focal Point's mandate and work on an ongoing basis. It set up a working group operating by consensus with responsibility for reviewing the Focal Point's semiannual reports.

malta/authority.delegate_statement: Malta explained that the Focal Point would consult petitioners and collect information from several sources. Its report would help the sanctions committees deliberate and decide.
malta/authority.adopted_document: Annex I calls for the Focal Point to deliver a confidential report of facts without recommending an outcome. If a relevant State or a committee member recommends proceeding with delisting, the sanctions committee decides using its regular procedures.
